name: Frontegg
description: Monitor Frontegg authentication platform for user management and access control compliance

config.setupInstructions:
1. Log in to Frontegg portal (https://portal.frontegg.com)
2. Select the Environment to monitor
3. Open Settings → API Tokens
4. Copy the Client ID and Secret (Api-Key)
5. Choose the matching region (US or EU)

credentialFields.label: Client ID
credentialFields.helpText: Frontegg Portal → [your environment] → Settings → API Tokens → Client ID

credentialFields.label: Secret
credentialFields.helpText: Frontegg Portal → [your environment] → Settings → API Tokens → Secret (Api-Key)
